summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 15, 2026, announcing that it will release third-quarter 2026 operating results on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, after the U.S. market close, with a management conference call the following day, October 28, 2026, at 3:00pm CET (10:00am EDT). The notice provides webcast and dial-in access details plus Investor Relations contacts. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine earnings-date announcement, not a special situation.
